artDirection: Premium preschool stop-motion claymation: tactile fingerprints and seams, rounded toy forms, warm studio light, saturated friendly color, no vector look, no text unless explicitly requested.

acceptedPrompts.bakery: A wide 4:3 handmade claymation bakery game backdrop with a large clear sky-blue arched window as the quiet central playfield, warm biscuit-brick walls, wooden counter ledges, small clay bowls, jars, whisk, cutting board and plants around the edges; tactile fingerprints and seams, soft stop-motion studio lighting, no characters, no text, no UI, no falling objects.
acceptedPrompts.raviChefTray: Using the canonical Ravi identity reference, make a full-body transparent-ready claymation cutout of the same cheerful South Asian child with warm brown skin, black wavy hair, round dark eyes and friendly smile, dressed as a mini-chef in a white baker coat, oversized white chef hat, red neckerchief and small gold star, holding a wide silver baking tray with both hands; centered, straight-on, complete silhouette, flat solid magenta background, no text, no shadow beyond the feet.
acceptedPrompts.title: A single handmade clay cookie-plaque title lockup reading exactly ‘Chocolate Chip Count’, every letter correctly formed, chunky raised dark-chocolate clay lettering on a warm golden biscuit plaque with a few chocolate-drop ornaments, centered isolated object, flat solid magenta background, no extra words.
acceptedPrompts.chip: One oversized chunky dark-brown chocolate chip made from tactile modeling clay, rounded preschool-safe silhouette, three-quarter front view, centered isolated object, flat solid green background, no cookie, no text.
acceptedPrompts.cookie: One plain round golden-brown clay cookie with a softly irregular handmade edge and subtle baked texture, absolutely no chocolate chips or marks, front-facing centered isolated object, flat solid magenta background, no text.
acceptedPrompts.balloons: A strict three-cell horizontal contact sheet containing exactly one red, one yellow, and one blue rounded clay balloon, consistent size and front view, each complete with a tiny tied nub, wide blank gutters between cells, flat solid magenta background, no strings, no highlights that look like letters, no text.
acceptedPrompts.recipeFrames: A strict three-cell horizontal contact sheet of empty rounded-square clay recipe frames, one mint green, one butter yellow, one sky blue, each with a thick tactile border and warm cream inset panel, consistent scale and centered in its cell, wide blank gutters, flat solid magenta background, no cookie, no symbols, no text.
acceptedPrompts.button: One blank wide rounded red clay button, thick pill shape with tactile handmade surface and soft lower shadow, centered isolated object, flat solid green background, no letters, no icons, no text.
acceptedPrompts.star: One cheerful golden-yellow five-point clay star set inside a round orange-gold clay medallion, chunky tactile preschool reward token, centered isolated object, flat solid magenta background, no text.
acceptedPrompts.gesture: One horizontal clay gesture cue made of a mint left arrow, a centered warm-brown pointing hand, and a blue right arrow, coherent single cutout, tactile rounded clay forms, centered isolated object, flat solid magenta background, no text.
acceptedPrompts.hubTile: Create a polished 6:5 game-library hub illustration for a premium preschool learning app, matching the referenced handmade claymation character and props. One instantly readable game moment staged like a delightful tabletop clay diorama: Ravi, the same cheerful South Asian child character with the same face, hair, red neckerchief, white baker coat and oversized white chef hat, stands centered holding a silver baking tray. Exactly THREE chunky dark-brown chocolate chips are visibly landing on the tray. Above him float three simple rounded clay balloons, one red, one yellow, one blue. Warm cookie-bakery setting, shallow depth, soft studio lighting, saturated friendly colors, rounded simplified toy forms, tactile fingerprints and clay seams, premium stop-motion miniature finish. Strong central silhouette, generous breathing room, all essential objects fully visible within safe margins. No text, no title, no letters, no numbers, no words, no UI, no icons, no borders, no gradients, no vector look, no photoreal humans.

processing: Generated sources were preserved unchanged. Foreground sources were locally keyed to alpha, deterministically cropped, alpha-inspected, and optimized to WebP. The hub source was resized to 640x533 JPEG; the social card was deterministically cropped to 1200x630 JPEG.
